message: with no role and a way to land on it
$reason: An option under a link inside a map: an `<a href>` in an `<svg>`, which the parser names `:svg:a` and Angular draws as an SVG `<a>` with its address — a link Chromium focuses and axe holds focusable (measured: Angular 22.2, Chromium 153, axe 4.13, which reports the option). axe looks through a role-less element unless it carries a global ARIA attribute or takes focus, so the link owns the option and a listbox may not own it, as with the same `<a href>` outside the map. The walk asked axe about the raw name, `:svg:a`, a tag it does not know, and passed the option; it asks about the local name the tag scan reads now.
